title: Honey Oat Porridge Bread
description: Honey Oat Porridge Bread made from a small batch of scratch dough.

steps.title: Soak the oats
steps.text: Pour boiling {water} over {oat}. Cool the porridge to lukewarm, about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Mix the dough
steps.text: Combine {bf}, {ww}, {honey}, {butter}, {yeast}, {salt} with the cooled porridge. Use room-temperature liquids and softened fat. Mix until no dry flour remains.

steps.title: Develop the dough
steps.text: Knead 6–8 minutes until smooth. For wet dough, fold in the bowl with damp hands.

steps.title: Let rise
steps.text: Cover and let rise 45–75 minutes at room temperature until about doubled.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Roll into a log and place in an 8-by-4-inch greased loaf pan.

steps.title: Proof
steps.text: Cover and proof 30–50 minutes until puffy; a light fingertip dent should return slowly.

steps.title: Heat the oven
steps.text: Preheat the Samsung oven to 375°F on conventional Bake.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake on the center rack until the loaf sounds hollow. Allow 34–39 minutes; verify 195°F at the center.

steps.title: Cool
steps.text: Cool on a rack for 60 minutes before slicing.

notes: Make ahead: weigh the dry ingredients the evening before. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: Yes. Cool completely and freeze sliced or individually wrapped for up to 2 months. Fridge reheat: wrap a serving in a damp towel and microwave for 15–25 seconds. Freezer reheat: thaw wrapped, then warm the same way. Serve with soup or gravy for a softer bite. Allow about 1–2 hours for rising and proofing in addition to mixing and baking. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/8 of recipe): 151 kcal, 4.9 g protein, 28.3 g total carbohydrate, 1.5 g fat, 2.0 g fiber, 197 mg sodium.
